title: The group of self-homotopy equivalences of A2n-polyhedra
extended_summary: This paper addresses a purely algebraic topology question about the group of self-homotopy equivalences of certain CW-complexes called A2n-polyhedra. The authors study the quotient group E(X)/E*(X), where E(X) is the group of self-homotopy equivalences of a space X and E*(X) consists of those inducing the identity on homology. The motivation is a realisability problem: whether arbitrary groups can appear as such self-equivalence groups or quotients.
